description: Who a site's forms may email. A form's `to` address gets submissions only when it is a verified site member or it confirmed by a one-click link we email it (no account, no sign-in, no site access). action: `list` (confirmed + waiting addresses), `status` (one address: member | confirmed | pending | expired | unconfirmed), `request` (email the confirm link; 7 days, single use; max 3 per address, 20 per site and 50 per account a day), `revoke` (stop form emails to a confirmed address). A publish already sends the link once by itself when a form emails an unconfirmed address. Never ask the user for the link — it goes to that inbox only.

email.description: The address (required for status, request, revoke)
